question: Pick the odd one out (Hint: Millets)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Potato**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Potato**:-

 
 
• **Potatoes are a good source of carbohydrates, dietary fiber, vitamin C, and potassium. **
 
• They can be eaten in a variety of ways, including baked, boiled, fried, and mashed.
 
• Potatoes are also used to make a variety of products, such as potato chips, french fries, and vodka.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Ragi:-**

 
 
• **It is also known as finger millet.**
 
• It is a small, dark-colored grain that is a good source of protein, fiber, and calcium.
 
• It is a staple food crop in many parts of Africa and India.
 
 
 
• **Bajra**:-
 
 
• **It is also known as pearl millet.**
 
• It is a drought-tolerant grain that is grown in many parts of Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.
 
• It is a good source of protein, fiber, and iron.
 
 
 
• **Jowar**:- 
 
 
• **It is also known as sorghum.**
 
• **It is also a millet.**
 
• **It is a versatile grain that can be used for food, fodder, and biofuels. **
 
• It is a good source of protein, fiber, and antioxidants.
